scientific_integrity: The theorems are supported by analytic exact-rational comparisons; the supplementary standard-library program checks small-size symbolic sign certificates and independent rational matrix inverses. No independent mathematical audit or authorship claims are made.
scientific_limitations: The full positive-gain phase diagram is proved only for ten vertices; the infinite-size statement compares gains one and two. Exactly two equal-feedback leaders, a unit path, and independent identically distributed noise are assumed. Further historical equivalence and independent validation are not excluded.
title: Reentrant finite-gain leader separation on paths: a sharp ten-vertex onset and an infinite reversal family
